ScrollDown.label: Scroll down the page
ScrollDown.description: Scrolls the page down by one viewport height

ScrollUp.label: Scroll up the page
ScrollUp.description: Scrolls the page up by one viewport height

ScrollTop.label: Go to top of page
ScrollTop.description: Scrolls to the very top of the page

ScrollBottom.label: Go to bottom of page
ScrollBottom.description: Scrolls to the very bottom of the page

OpenTab.label: Go to tab or open URL
OpenTab.description: Opens a URL or switches to existing tab. Auto-switches if tab already open.

GoogleIt.label: Google something on the web
GoogleIt.description: Opens Google with your query. Use when user wants to look something up online, google it, or find info on the internet.

YouTubeIt.label: Find videos on YouTube
YouTubeIt.description: Opens YouTube with your query. Use when user wants to find videos, watch something, or look up on YouTube.

params.query: Required - what to find on YouTube

CloseTab.label: Close a tab
CloseTab.description: Closes a tab by ID or name. Say 'close the google tab' or 'close facebook'.

params.tabId: Optional - numeric tab ID to close
params.name: Optional - tab title/name for fuzzy matching (e.g. 'google', 'facebook')

GoBack.label: Go back in history
GoBack.description: Navigates back in the current tab's history

GoForward.label: Go forward in history
GoForward.description: Navigates forward in the current tab's history

SwitchView.label: Switch between HUD and orb view
SwitchView.description: Switches between fullscreen HUD mode and floating orb mode. Browser mode shows the page with floating orb.

SetTheme.label: Change orb character style
SetTheme.description: Changes the orb persona/character. Three styles: robot (Om-E), kawaii (cute cat), atom (science orb).

ShowPrompt.label: Show the chat prompt
ShowPrompt.description: Shows the text input area for typing messages

HidePrompt.label: Hide the chat prompt
HidePrompt.description: Hides the text input area for typing messages

ShowChats.label: Show chats panel
ShowChats.description: Opens the chats sidebar to display saved conversations. If in orb view, switches to HUD first then opens sidebar. Use when user wants to SEE their chats.

HideChats.label: Hide chats panel
HideChats.description: Closes the chats sidebar UI panel. Does NOT delete chats - just hides the panel from view.

ToggleChats.label: Toggle chats panel
ToggleChats.description: Opens or closes the chats panel

GetChatList.label: Get chat list data (internal)
GetChatList.description: Returns JSON array of chats with id, title, date_short, message_count. Internal/programmatic use - for UI display use ShowChats instead.

params.project_id: Optional - filter by project (use 'default' for unassigned)

LoadChat.label: Load a chat
LoadChat.description: Returns full chat content including all messages. Use chat NUMBER from list OR chat_id directly.

params.chat: Optional - chat NUMBER from visible chats list
params.tail: Optional - only return last N messages (default: all)
params.offset: Optional - skip last N messages before tail (for pagination)

CreateChat.label: Create a new chat
CreateChat.description: Creates a new chat file and returns the chat_id

AppendMessage.label: Append a message to a chat
AppendMessage.description: Appends a user or assistant message to a chat. Creates chat if chat_id is null.

params.chat_id: Chat ID (null to create new chat)
params.title: Optional - title for new chat
params.page_url: Optional - page URL for new chat metadata
params.page_title: Optional - page title for new chat metadata

AppendUserMessage.label: Append a user message to current chat
AppendUserMessage.description: Appends a user message. Uses CURRENT_CHAT_ID or creates new chat.

params.page_url: Optional - page URL for new chat metadata
params.page_title: Optional - page title for new chat metadata

AppendAssistantMessage.label: Append an assistant message to current chat
AppendAssistantMessage.description: Appends an assistant message. Uses CURRENT_CHAT_ID or creates new chat.

RenameChat.label: Rename a chat
RenameChat.description: Updates the title of a chat by number, name, or current. Say 'rename X chat to Y' or 'rename it to Y'.

params.chat: Optional - chat NUMBER (omit for current chat)
params.name: Optional - existing chat title for fuzzy matching
params.title: Required - the new title

DeleteChat.label: Delete a chat
DeleteChat.description: Permanently deletes a chat by number, name, or current. Say 'delete the X chat' for name.

params.chat: Optional - chat NUMBER (omit for current chat)
params.name: Optional - chat title for fuzzy matching

GetCurrentChat.label: Get the current active chat
GetCurrentChat.description: Returns the current chat ID and chat data

SetCurrentChat.label: Activate a chat
SetCurrentChat.description: Makes a chat active by number or name. Use number if visible, name for fuzzy match.

params.chat: Optional - the chat NUMBER from visible chats list
params.name: Optional - chat title for fuzzy matching (e.g. 'my project', 'yesterday')

SearchChats.label: Search chats by title or content
SearchChats.description: Searches all chats for a keyword or phrase. Extract the key search term from the user's request and search. Don't ask for clarification - just search with what they gave you.

params.query: Required - search query string (extract from user request)

CloseSearch.label: Close the chat search
CloseSearch.description: Closes/clears the chat search box and shows all chats again. Use when user wants to exit search mode without closing the sidebar.

GetLLMConfig.label: Get LLM configuration
GetLLMConfig.description: Returns current LLM config including providers and settings

SetLLMProvider.label: Switch active LLM provider
SetLLMProvider.description: Changes which provider is used for LLM calls

SetLLMEndpoint.label: Set LLM endpoint URL
SetLLMEndpoint.description: Updates the API endpoint for a provider

SetLLMModel.label: Set LLM model
SetLLMModel.description: Changes the model for a provider

SetLLMAPIKey.label: Set API key
SetLLMAPIKey.description: Sets the API key for a provider

ReloadLLMConfig.label: Reload LLM config
ReloadLLMConfig.description: Reloads the server-side LLM agent config from disk

LLMChat.label: Send message to LLM
LLMChat.description: Send a chat message to the configured LLM and get a response

params.chat_id: Optional - chat ID to associate response with
